program.name: audren
docs: Audren — Multi-Asset Shielded Settlement & Protocol-Agnostic DeFi Execution Protocol on Solana (Pinocchio + sBPFv3).
Zero trusted setup: pure Ristretto255 Multi-Base Binary Triptych (32/64/128-note rings) + Agave native Bulletproofs.

accounts.name: poolState
docs: Root pool state PDA (192 bytes, magic 'AUDRNPL1').

fields.name: activeLanes
docs: 0 or 1 = Lane 0 only; 2..=16 = parallel lanes 0..N-1 active.

accounts.name: epochPage
docs: Structure-of-Arrays note page PDA (6,240 bytes, 32 notes/page, magic 'AUDRNPG1').
Pure-RPC scan slice: dataSlice { offset: 64, length: 1056 } reads viewTags[32] + ephemeralPks[32].

fields.name: viewTags
docs: Offsets 64..96: 1-byte ECDH view tag per note.

accounts.name: appendLaneState
docs: Parallel append lane metadata PDA (64 bytes, magic 'AUDRNLN1') for lanes 1..15.

accounts.name: solVaultSentinel
docs: Native SOL vault sentinel PDA (16 bytes, magic 'AUDRNSL1').

accounts.name: pageRentSentinel
docs: Self-balancing page-rent vault sentinel PDA (16 bytes, magic 'AUDRNRN1') used by Lane 0 and Lanes 1..15.

accounts.name: proofBufferHeader
docs: 48-byte ProofBuffer header followed by `expectedLen` payload bytes (max 9,984 B).

accounts.name: nullifierPda
docs: 0-byte program-owned marker account proving a note nullifier has been spent.

instructions.name: initPool
docs: Tag 0: Initialize a shielded pool, Lane 0 page 0, SOL vault, and self-balancing page-rent vault.

accounts.name: pageRentVault
docs: Lane 0 rent vault sentinel PDA ['audren_rent', poolId].

arguments.name: auditorPk
docs: Non-zero Ristretto255 K_aud for InstitutionalAudited; 32 zero bytes for Permissionless.

instructions.name: openPage
docs: Tag 1: Permissionlessly seal Lane 0's current EpochPage (when <=4 slots remain) and self-fund the next page.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Tag 2: Shield Native SOL (6 accounts) or Classic SPL / Token-2022 tokens (9+ accounts) into a stealth note.
For Native SOL: [depositor, pool, outPage, solVault, rentVault, systemProgram].
For SPL / Token-2022: [depositor, pool, outPage, mint, depositorAta, vaultAta, tokenProgram, rentVault, systemProgram, ...optionalTransferHookAccounts].

accounts.name: depositor
docs: Source funds authority and rent-fee payer.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PoolState PDA (writable on Lane 0, read-only on Lanes 1..15).

accounts.name: tokenProgram
docs: SPL/Token-2022 only: Classic SPL Token or Token-2022 program.

accounts.name: splRentVault
docs: SPL/Token-2022 only: PageRentVault or LaneRentVault PDA.

arguments.name: flags
docs: bit0 = isNativeSol, bit1 = feeFromAmount (Native SOL only: deducts page rent fee from amount so retiring wallets can sweep to 0 lamports).

instructions.name: transfer
docs: Tag 3: Full-private 1-in -> 2-out multi-asset transfer hiding sender, recipient, token mint, and amount.
Trailing accounts `[7..7+pages]` are 1 (m=5), 2 (m=6), or 4 (m=7) read-only input EpochPages in ascending pageId order.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PoolState PDA (writable on Lane 0, read-only on Lanes 1..15).

accounts.name: zkProgram
docs: Agave native ZK ElGamal Proof program.

accounts.name: inputPage0
docs: First input EpochPage (followed by 0, 1, or 3 more input pages for m=5/6/7).

arguments.name: m
docs: Triptych exponent: 5 (32 notes), 6 (64 notes), or 7 (128 notes).

arguments.name: cPay
docs: Agave Pedersen value commitment for payment output.

arguments.name: cChg
docs: Agave Pedersen value commitment for change output.

arguments.name: proofBundleAndPqEnvelope
docs: Concatenation: triptychProof (929..1732 B) || crossBase2 (256 B) || rangeU128 (736 B) || [auditorAssetProof (192 B)] || [optional PQ ML-KEM-768 envelope].

instructions.name: merge
docs: Tag 4: Full-private 2-in -> 1-out consolidation of two same-asset notes.
Trailing accounts `[8..]` carry `inputPages(m1)` + `inputPages(m2)` read-only EpochPages (combined ring <= 128 slots).

accounts.name: pool
docs: PoolState PDA (writable on Lane 0, read-only on Lanes 1..15).

accounts.name: zkProgram
docs: Agave native ZK ElGamal Proof program.

accounts.name: inputPageLeg1_0
docs: Leg 1 input EpochPage(s), followed by Leg 2 input EpochPage(s).

arguments.name: proofBundle
docs: Concatenation: triptych1 || triptych2 || crossBase1 (128 B) || rangeU64 (672 B) || [auditorAssetProof (192 B)].

instructions.name: execViaEscrow
docs: Tag 5: Single-transaction protocol-agnostic shielded DeFi action via sharded isolated escrow PDA (DEX swaps, supply lending, yield vaults, liquid staking, perp LP, RWA mint/redeem).
Supports optional native self-paying relayerFee bound in ctx_hash on either input mint (bit2=0) or output mint (bit2=1).

Trailing accounts `[16..16+pages]` are read-only input EpochPages; `[16+pages..]` are external target program accounts (up to 80) with `escrow`, `escrow_in`, `escrow_out` at arbitrary indices `(escrowIdx, escrowInIdx, escrowOutIdx)`.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PoolState PDA (writable on Lane 0, read-only on Lanes 1..15).

accounts.name: zkProgram
docs: Agave native ZK ElGamal Proof program.

accounts.name: mintOut
docs: Output SPL / Token-2022 mint (must differ from mintIn).

accounts.name: targetProgram
docs: Executable external DeFi / DEX / vault / lending program.

accounts.name: feeRecipientAta
docs: Relayer fee token account (writable when relayerFee > 0; read-only System Program placeholder when 0).

arguments.name: flags
docs: bit0 = hasChange, bit1 = allowPartialRefund, bit2 = feeOnOutput (0=mintIn fee, 1=mintOut fee).

arguments.name: relayerFee
docs: Optional relayer fee bound inside ctx_hash (0 for direct / subsidized execution).

arguments.name: escrowIdx
docs: Index of escrow PDA inside actionAccounts.

arguments.name: escrowInIdx
docs: Index of escrow_in ATA inside actionAccounts.

arguments.name: escrowOutIdx
docs: Index of escrow_out ATA inside actionAccounts.

arguments.name: variableTail
docs: Concatenation: [changeNote(193) + cChg(32) + crossBase1(160) + rangeU64(672) if bit0] || [refundDesc(129) if bit1] || triptychProof || targetInstructionData(targetDataLen).

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Tag 6: Full-private spend to a public SOL or SPL/Token-2022 recipient with optional native self-paying relayerFee, atomic WSOL->Native SOL unwrap (unwrapWsol), and optional hidden change note.
Full withdrawals (hasChange=false) always succeed even when pool.paused=true across all three modes (non-custodial escape hatch).
Native SOL accounts `[7..10]`: [feeRecipient, solVault (wr), recipient (wr)], followed by input EpochPages.
SPL/Token-2022 accounts `[7..13]`: [feeRecipient, vaultAuth (ro), mint (ro), vaultAta (wr), recipientAta (wr), tokenProgram (ro)], followed by input EpochPages and optional TransferHook accounts.
Unwrap WSOL accounts `[7..14]`: [feeRecipient, vaultAuth (ro), wsolMint (ro), vaultAta (wr), recipientWallet (wr), classicTokenProgram (ro), unwrapPda (wr)], followed by input EpochPages.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PoolState PDA (writable on Lane 0 with change; read-only on Lanes 1..15 or full withdraw).

accounts.name: outPage
docs: Output EpochPage PDA (writable only when hasChange=true).

accounts.name: zkProgram
docs: Agave native ZK ElGamal Proof program.

accounts.name: feeRecipient
docs: Relayer fee wallet (Native SOL / unwrapWsol) or token ATA (SPL/Token-2022) when relayerFee > 0; read-only System Program placeholder when 0.

accounts.name: recipientOrRecipientAta
docs: SPL/Token-2022: recipientAta (wr); unwrapWsol: recipient Native SOL wallet (wr).

accounts.name: tokenProgram
docs: SPL/Token-2022 / unwrapWsol: Classic SPL Token or Token-2022 program.

accounts.name: unwrapAcc
docs: unwrapWsol only: ephemeral 1-shot WSOL PDA ['audren_unwrap', poolId, nullifier] created and closed atomically.

arguments.name: flags
docs: bit0 = isNativeSol, bit1 = hasChange, bit2 = unwrapWsol (WSOL note -> Native SOL payout).

arguments.name: amountOut
docs: Net amount delivered to recipient (total spent from note is amountOut + relayerFee).

arguments.name: relayerFee
docs: Optional self-paying relayer fee bound inside ctx_hash.

arguments.name: changeAndTriptychProof
docs: Concatenation: [changeNote(193) + cChg(32) + crossBase1(160) + rangeU64(672) if hasChange] || triptychProof.

instructions.name: setPaused
docs: Tag 7: Governance emergency pause/unpause. Never grants custody or blocks full withdrawals.

instructions.name: writeProofBuffer
docs: Tag 8: Upload one <=768 B chunk (in any order) into an ephemeral ProofBuffer PDA (max 9,984 B payload).

instructions.name: execBuffered
docs: Tag 9: Execute Transfer (3), Merge (4), ExecViaEscrow (5), or Withdraw (6) directly from a completed ProofBuffer PDA, atomically closing the buffer and refunding 100% of rent to payer.
Accounts: [0] proofBuffer (wr), [1..] exact account list of the inner instruction (where [1] = payer/authority).

accounts.name: proofBuffer
docs: Completed ProofBuffer PDA (closed atomically after execution).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Buffer authority & inner instruction payer (followed by remaining inner instruction accounts).

instructions.name: closeProofBuffer
docs: Tag 10: Close an abandoned/unexecuted ProofBuffer PDA and reclaim 100% of its rent to authority.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Buffer authority and rent refund recipient.

instructions.name: initLane
docs: Tag 11: Sequentially activate parallel append lane 1..15 inside an existing pool for lock-free concurrent writes.

accounts.name: lanePage0
docs: Initial EpochPage PDA for this lane (pageId = (laneId << 56) | 0).

instructions.name: openLanePage
docs: Tag 12: Permissionlessly seal a parallel lane's current EpochPage (when <=4 slots remain) and self-fund the next page with read-only PoolState.

definedTypes.name: noteWire
docs: 193-byte note wire block (viewTag + ephemeralPk + stealthPk + assetTag + commitment + 64 B ciphertext).

definedTypes.name: dynamicOutputWire
docs: 129-byte stealth output descriptor used when assetTag and commitment are computed on-chain (Deposit, ExecViaEscrow).

definedTypes.name: pageHeader
docs: 64-byte EpochPage header stored at byte offsets 0..64.

pdas.name: pool
docs: PoolState configuration and Lane 0 rollover state (192 B).

pdas.name: epochPage
docs: Fixed 6,240 B Structure-of-Arrays EpochPage storing up to 32 notes. pageId = (laneId << 56) | seq.

pdas.name: nullifier
docs: 0-byte NullifierPDA owned by Audren; its existence permanently prevents double-spends.

pdas.name: vaultAuth
docs: System-owned signer PDA that owns every SPL / Token-2022 pool vault ATA.

pdas.name: solVault
docs: Program-owned 16 B sentinel PDA holding shielded Native SOL lamports.

pdas.name: pageRentVault
docs: Program-owned 16 B sentinel PDA funding permissionless Lane 0 EpochPage rollovers.

pdas.name: escrow
docs: Sharded (0..16) isolated signer PDA for atomic ExecViaEscrow external DeFi CPIs.

pdas.name: unwrap
docs: One-shot WSOL token account PDA created and atomically closed during Withdraw(unwrap_wsol) to deliver Native SOL with zero residual rent.

pdas.name: proofBuffer
docs: Ephemeral PDA staging oversized (>4 KiB) proof/action payloads across <=768 B chunks.

pdas.name: appendLane
docs: AppendLaneState (64 B) for lock-free parallel append lanes 1..15.

pdas.name: laneRentVault
docs: Program-owned 16 B sentinel PDA funding permissionless rollovers for parallel lane 1..15.

errors.name: invalidInstruction
errors.message: Malformed instruction tag, length, or argument encoding.

errors.name: invalidAccount
errors.message: Missing, unwritable, wrong-owner, or aliased account.

errors.name: invalidPda
errors.message: Account address does not match expected PDA derivation.

errors.name: invalidMagic
errors.message: Account 8-byte ASCII magic discriminator mismatch.

errors.name: unsupportedVersion
errors.message: Account protocol_version is not supported by this program build.

errors.name: poolPaused
errors.message: Pool is paused by governance authority (full withdrawals remain open).

errors.name: unauthorized
errors.message: Required signer is missing or does not match pool/buffer authority.

errors.name: unsupportedTokenProgram
errors.message: Token program must be Classic SPL Token or Token-2022.

errors.name: unsafeMintExtension
errors.message: Mint carries an unsupported or unsafe extension.

errors.name: zeroAmount
errors.message: Deposit, swap, or withdrawal amount must be strictly greater than zero.

errors.name: pageFull
errors.message: Target EpochPage is already closed or has reached PAGE_CAPACITY (32 notes).

errors.name: pageNotReady
errors.message: Current EpochPage still has more than PAGE_ROLLOVER_HEADROOM (4) free slots.

errors.name: pageEmpty
errors.message: Input EpochPage contains zero notes and cannot form a Triptych ring.

errors.name: duplicateOrUnorderedPages
errors.message: Input EpochPage IDs must be strictly ascending without duplicates.

errors.name: wrongPool
errors.message: EpochPage or lane belongs to a different pool_id or wrong active page_id.

errors.name: nullifierAlreadySpent
errors.message: NullifierPDA already exists (note is already spent or duplicated in Merge).

errors.name: invalidPoint
errors.message: Bytes are not a canonical compressed Ristretto255 curve point (or forbidden identity).

errors.name: invalidScalar
errors.message: Bytes are not a canonical Curve25519 scalar (< L).

errors.name: invalidTriptychProof
errors.message: Multi-Base Binary Triptych ring proof verification failed.

errors.name: invalidCrossBaseProof
errors.message: Cross-base Pedersen bridge proof (1-output or 2-output) verification failed.

errors.name: invalidRangeProof
errors.message: Native Agave Bulletproof range proof CPI verification failed.

errors.name: invalidAuditorProof
errors.message: Verifiable Auditor ElGamal asset-tag proof verification failed.

errors.name: missingAuditorKey
errors.message: InstitutionalAudited pool requires a valid non-identity auditor_pk.

errors.name: invalidEscrowShard
errors.message: Escrow shard_id must be in 0..16.

errors.name: invalidTargetProgram
errors.message: Target program must be executable and cannot be Audren, System, ZK, or Token.

errors.name: escrowAuthorityAltered
errors.message: Escrow PDA owner, data length, or lamport balance was altered by target CPI.

errors.name: escrowAccountAltered
errors.message: Escrow token account owner, delegate, close_authority, or balance was altered.

errors.name: slippageExceeded
errors.message: Net output received in pool vault is below min_amount_out (or zero).

errors.name: unexpectedPartialFill
errors.message: Target program left unspent input tokens when allow_partial_refund flag was not set.

errors.name: arithmeticOverflow
errors.message: Checked integer arithmetic overflow or underflow.

errors.name: insufficientPageRent
errors.message: Insufficient lamports to fund page rent.

errors.name: invalidProofBuffer
errors.message: Invalid ProofBuffer header, authority, chunk index, length, or completion mask.

errors.name: invalidLane
errors.message: Invalid parallel append lane_id (must be 1..16 and sequentially initialized).
